items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: I can't think of anybody except for Paul O.

ctx.x: I can't think of anybody except for Paul O.
He had, let's see, he had Wash with him one time. That's right, Wash was with him. Then after come on this boy Hill with him, how do you call him? Or Al? Maniel Paul. Yeah.
